definitions.gloss: wild boar hot pot; boar meat simmered in a pot
definitions.explanation: A winter {鍋|なべ} dish of thinly sliced wild boar meat simmered with vegetables in a miso or soy-based broth. A regional speciality of mountain areas, especially {丹波|たんば} in Hyogo Prefecture.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}が{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: In winter I look forward to wild boar hot pot.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}の{宿|やど}で{牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: We ate wild boar hot pot at an inn in the mountains.

examples.japanese: {味噌|みそ}{仕立|じた}ての{牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}は{猪|いのしし}{肉|にく}の{臭|くさ}みが{消|き}えて{食|た}べやすい。
examples.english: Miso-based wild boar hot pot loses the gaminess of the boar meat and is easy to eat.

notes:
Named for the way the sliced boar meat is arranged on the plate like the petals of a {牡丹|ぼたん} (peony). Part of an old set of flower names for game meat, used when eating meat was officially discouraged.

GAME-MEAT FLOWER NAMES:
- {牡丹|ぼたん}: wild boar ({猪|いのしし})
- もみじ: deer ({鹿|しか})
- さくら: horse ({馬|うま})

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}を{食|た}べる: to eat wild boar hot pot
- {味噌|みそ}{仕立|じた}ての{牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}: miso-based boar hot pot
- {牡丹鍋|ぼたんなべ}の{季節|きせつ}: boar hot pot season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- しし{鍋|なべ}: boar hot pot — the plainer name for the same dish
- もみじ{鍋|なべ}: venison hot pot — the deer counterpart
